items.title: Options Traders Flock to Bullish Wagers
items.summary: Traders are snapping up bullish bets in the options market. A measure called "skew" fell Friday to its lowest level since December 2024, show Cboe Global Markets Data. A lower skew typically signals that prices for call options are more expensive relative to put options.

items.title: The Bulls Have Been Rewarded This Week
items.summary: There's been a rush for bullish stock bets this week. More than 10 million call options tied to the State Street SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust traded in a single session earlier this week, the highest one-day sum on record, according to Cboe Global Markets data.
